dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Just a moment — I've got everything you want noted in my head... This one's for you, and the next one's for...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything good to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Everything is good here, my friend! If I'm being honest, our meat is solid, our fish is even better, but either could compete with our signature secret sauce.

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: You could literally put this sauce on a leather boot and it'd still taste amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Look like your stall is really popular!

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Popularity isn't all it's cracked up to be, my friend! Back in the day, I'd be lucky to hit twenty orders a day. It was peaceful, quiet... I could even sneak in a little afternoon nap.

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Then out of nowhere, some reviewer went and raved about my stall in "Pioneers." Now? People are lining up just to get a taste.

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Naps? Forget about it! The second my butt touches a chair, customers are nagging me to get back to the grill... If I ever find out who wrote that article...

dialogues.speaker: Razumovsky
dialogues.text: Alright! Just let me know if there's anything you want to eat. The orders might be piling up, but I know exactly who's next in line!
